verdict.rationale: Capacities documents offline-first operation, but changes still sync to its own service once back online. The pack has no evidence of a local-only mode or a self-hosted sync backend the user operates. Offline caching and scheduled exports are adjacent features, not a way to run the system without the vendor's cloud.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the whole system without the vendor's cloud — local-only mode or a self-hosted sync backend I operate myself
